missionTitle: Youth and elders, together in one room
missionBody:
We believe that intergenerational connections are key to creating a vibrant and connected community. Our programs and initiatives are designed to bring youth and elders together, fostering relationships that bring joy and meaning to all involved.

Whether you're a student who wants to perform or a community that wants to host, we would love to hear from you!

featuredQuote.text: Thank you for everything you're doing to build in-person community and to bring joy into people's lives. It was so clear how much people enjoy the experience you have created.
featuredQuote.attribution: Dr. Vivek Murthy — U.S. Surgeon General, Dec 2024

heroSubtitle: Student musicians, dancers and artists bring live performances to senior communities across Greater Boston and leave with friendships, stories and wisdom in return.
